promotion_rule: Only evidence files whose row verification_state is verified, promotion_eligible is true, and all three target fields are source_verified may create a canonical turnout observation.

current_tranche.materialization_note: This tranche adds Mogotio (161), Laikipia North (165), Molo (166) and Njoro (167), independently source-verified in the p23-turnout-tranche-a session against freshly downloaded, sha256-confirmed official IEBC Form 34B PDFs (form_id = constituency_code + 277628, with the portal session first reset from its default 2022-2027 by-election context to the 2022 general election via index.php?r=common/set-election&id=5). Each row was read directly from a clearly legible TOTAL row and reconciles exactly to the existing governed 2022 registered-voter denominator and to the four-candidate valid-vote breakdown on the same row. Laikipia North's page 2 scan is rotated 180 degrees; the TOTAL row was instead read from the upright page 3, and page 1 independently confirmed constituency identity and standard column order. Molo's page 2 scan is likewise rotated 180 degrees but was still directly legible upside down; both the green-shaded TOTAL band and a targeted crop were read in that orientation and reconcile exactly. Three constituencies reviewed in the same batch were withheld for the same genuine prison/special-polling-station denominator-gap pattern documented for Keiyo North, Emgwen and Baringo Central in the prior commits: Eldama Ravine (162, 25-voter gap matching Eldama Ravine Prison), Laikipia West (163, 121-voter gap matching three special stations -- Rumuruti, T/Fall Prison and T/Fall Women -- summed together), and Laikipia East (164, 140-voter gap matching Nanyuki Prison). All are left unresolved rather than forced through.

canonical_rebuild_sync.note: The canonical full-build output was synchronized after deterministic rebuild drift was detected. This audit metadata does not authorize any additional geography or value promotion.

invariants: No county, ward, media, citizen-tally or candidate-party value is inherited or substituted.
OCR consensus is never sufficient for promotion without a separate source-image verification record.
Registered voters must reconcile exactly to the existing governed P23 constituency voter denominator.
Total valid votes plus rejected ballots must not exceed registered voters.
Turnout must be derived only from the three verified source integers and remain in [0,100].
An unresolved or unreadable constituency remains in the 290-row audit and creates no canonical series or observation.
Adding further verified evidence files may only reduce existing P23 turnout slots; it may not create new governed slots.
Arithmetic-mismatch rows remain promotion-blocked even when their component integers are source-verified.

scale_plan.next_step: Continue independent official Form 34B source review or governed closure for the remaining P23 turnout rows; preserve all arithmetic conflicts, incomplete rows and ambiguous TOTAL labels without inference.
scale_plan.batch_rule: Source review may proceed in parallel, but canonical promotion remains a single deterministic reducer over independently source-verified rows.
scale_plan.phase_complete_when: All 290 constituency turnout slots are source-backed verified observations or have an independently approved governed evidence closure under the P23 extraction contract.
